description: Yu Ding at Texas A&M University publishes ten-minute observations covering the first four years of operation of inland and offshore wind turbines. Inland records span 2008–2011 and offshore records 2007–2010. The September 2021 Zenodo ZIP is freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0. Its environmental variables follow the accompanying first dataset, but wind speed and turbulence are measured on turbines while most other conditions come from nearby masts. The series can support power-response calibration and comparisons of operating change over time in wind-energy simulations. Farm identities, exact turbine count and internal file formats are not established by the public description. Mast and turbine measurement sources must not be treated as equivalent without checking. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this longer-history collection. It is distinct from the shorter six-turbine dataset. Data quality, maintenance events and uncertainty were not independently assessed.
